variables.name: ENABLE_BYTEBUFFER_OPTIMIZATIONS
variables.comment: * Controls whether no-copy optimizations for direct ByteBuffers are enabled.

variables.name: DEFAULT_TAG_SIZE_BITS
variables.comment:
* The default tag size when one is not specified. Default to
     * full-length tags (128-bits or 16 octets).

variables.name: lastGlobalMessageSize
variables.comment: * Keeps track of the last used block size.

variables.name: previousKey
variables.comment: * The previously used key to prevent key + nonce (IV) reuse.

variables.name: previousIv
variables.comment: * The previously used nonce (IV) to prevent key + nonce reuse.

variables.name: mustInitialize
variables.comment:
* When set this instance must be initialized before use again. This prevents key
     * and IV reuse.

variables.name: buf
variables.comment: * The byte array containing the bytes written.

variables.name: tagLengthInBytes
variables.comment: * The length of the AEAD cipher tag in bytes.

methods.name: private boolean arraysAreEqual(byte[] a, byte[] b)
methods.comment:
Constant-time array comparison.  Since we are using this to compare keys, we want to
     * ensure there's no opportunity for a timing attack.

methods.comment:
* Returns whether reusing nonces is allowed (aka, whether this is nonce misuse-resistant).
     * Most AEAD ciphers are not, but some are specially constructed so that reusing a key/nonce
     * pair is safe.
